newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE APRIL 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE APRIL 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- U.S. President Bill Clinton to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu today to try and save the peace process in the Middle-East.
-- Local taxes to rise less than two percent in 1997 in France.
-- Belgian unions urge workers of Renault assembly plant in Vilvoorde, Belgium to resume work after they went on strike to protest Renault's decision to shut down the plant.
-- France Telecom to cut prices by nine percent in 1997 and 1998, and by some yearly 4.5 percent through 2000, said chairman Michel Bon.
-- GEC refuses conditions set by the French government for a merger project between GEC-Alsthom and Framatome.
